_doc: Shared primitive -> affected capabilities/contracts -> required regression families (UNIVERSAL_TEST_PATTERNS keys). Input to impact-based scheduling after a deployment: qa/runner/lib/contracts.mjs impactPlan() maps a fix report's changed_primitives (preferred) or files_changed (matched against file_path_hints) to the families and capabilities to retest FIRST. A changed execution primitive triggers broad AI-mutation regression; a CSS-only change does not trigger long-context runs unless impact says so. Fix reports currently carry no changed_primitives field - the Home PC is asked to add one (see qa/contracts/README.md).

ExecutionResultEnvelope.description: How a Brain mutation's actual result is represented and rendered as a receipt.

CanonicalRead.description: How Brain answers state questions from live data (context pack assembly, grounding precedence).
CanonicalRead.blast_radius_when_changed: BROAD - every Brain read and every continuity invariant

ContextCollectionEnvelope.description: Capped entity collections in the context pack and their metadata (returnedCount/totalCount/isTruncated) plus named-entity lookups.
ContextCollectionEnvelope.blast_radius_when_changed: MEDIUM-BROAD - every entity type with a capped list

ResourceLifecycle.description: archive/restore/end/restore state machines and the archived-parent policy applied to children.

OrganizationContext_TenantAuthorization.description: Organization selector semantics, has_company_access, RLS scopes, persona authorization.
OrganizationContext_TenantAuthorization.blast_radius_when_changed: SECURITY-BROAD - all tenant-scoped resources; run the SQL persona matrix first

PendingActionBinding.description: How a clarification's pending action is stored and how affirmatives bind to it (pending_action_id, actionType, canonical ids).
PendingActionBinding.blast_radius_when_changed: BROAD across every confirmable Brain action

ApprovalEngine.description: Approval creation, domain authorization, decide_approval idempotency and deferred execution.

UI_Presentation_Only.description: CSS, copy, layout changes with no data/logic path.
UI_Presentation_Only.blast_radius_when_changed: NARROW - do not schedule long-context runs from this alone

scheduling_policy._doc: Order applied by the scheduler when a deployment changes (impactPlan()).
order: capabilities matching affected_capabilities_glob of changed primitives
high-risk universal patterns (CROSS_ORG_ISOLATION, UNAUTHORIZED_ACTOR, MUTATION_TRUTH, PENDING_ACTION_CONFIRMATION)
scheduling_policy.long_context_trigger: only when changed primitives include CanonicalRead or PendingActionBinding, or a fix report explicitly names continuity
